<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en-GB">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Calder Family Plumbing | Trusted Plumbers in Leeds</title>
<meta name="description" content="Family-run plumbers in Leeds. Emergency call-outs 24/7, boilers, bathrooms, leaks and drains. Fixed prices agreed before we start.">
<style>
  :root {
    --navy: #0f2a3d;
    --navy-2: #173d57;
    --teal: #1b7f86;
    --teal-light: #e3f2f3;
    --copper: #c26a2e;
    --copper-dark: #a4541e;
    --cream: #faf7f2;
    --white: #ffffff;
    --ink: #1d2a33;
    --muted: #5b6b76;
    --line: #e4e0d8;
    --radius: 14px;
    --shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(15, 42, 61, 0.08);
    --max: 1160px;
  }

  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
  html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
  body {
    margin: 0;
    font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
    color: var(--ink);
    background: var(--cream);
    line-height: 1.6;
    font-size: 16px;
  }
  img, svg { display: block; max-width: 100%; }
  a { color: var(--teal); text-decoration: none; }
  a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
  :focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--copper); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 4px; }

  h1, h2, h3, h4 { line-height: 1.2; color: var(--navy); margin: 0 0 .5em; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
  h1 { font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 4.5vw, 3.4rem); }
  h2 { font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 3vw, 2.4rem); }
  h3 { font-size: 1.2rem; }
  p { margin: 0 0 1em; }

  .container { width: min(var(--max), 92%); margin: 0 auto; }
  section { padding: clamp(60px, 8vw, 96px) 0; }
  .eyebrow {
    display: inline-block;
    font-size: .8rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: .12em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--copper-dark);
    margin-bottom: .75rem;
  }
  .section-head { max-width: 640px; margin-bottom: 48px; }
  .section-head p { color: var(--muted); font-size: 1.05rem; }

  .skip-link {
    position: absolute; left: -999px; top: 8px;
    background: var(--navy); color: #fff; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 6px; z-index: 100;
  }
  .skip-link:focus { left: 8px; }

  /* Buttons */
  .btn {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: .5rem;
    padding: .9rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem;
    border: 2px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .15s ease, background .2s, color .2s;
    text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; font-family: inherit;
  }
  .btn:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); text-decoration: none; }
  .btn-primary { background: var(--copper); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(194,106,46,.3); }
  .btn-primary:hover { background: var(--copper-dark); color: #fff; }
  .btn-outline { border-color: var(--navy); color: var(--navy); background: transparent; }
  .btn-outline:hover { background: var(--navy); color: #fff; }
  .btn-light { background: #fff; color: var(--navy); }
  .btn-light:hover { background: var(--teal-light); color: var(--navy); }
  .btn svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; flex-shrink: 0; }

  /* Header */
  .site-header {
    position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 50;
    background: rgba(250, 247, 242, .92);
    backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .nav {
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
    height: 76px; gap: 1rem;
  }
  .logo { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .6rem; color: var(--navy); font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.1rem; }
  .logo:hover { text-decoration: none; }
  .logo-mark {
    width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--navy);
    display: grid; place-items: center;
  }
  .logo small { display: block; font-weight: 600; font-size: .72rem; color: var(--muted); letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; }
  .nav-links { display: flex; gap: 1.75rem; list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
  .nav-links a { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; font-size: .95rem; }
  .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--teal); text-decoration: none; }
  .nav-cta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .75rem; }
  .nav-phone { font-weight: 700; color: var(--navy); font-size: .95rem; }

  /* Hero */
  .hero {
    position: relative; overflow: hidden;
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 85% 20%, rgba(27,127,134,.18), transparent 45%),
      linear-gradient(160deg, var(--navy) 0%, var(--navy-2) 100%);
    color: #fff;
    padding: clamp(70px, 9vw, 120px) 0 clamp(80px, 10vw, 130px);
  }
  .hero::after {
    content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: -1px; height: 60px;
    background: var(--cream);
    clip-path: ellipse(60% 100% at 50% 100%);
  }
  .hero-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.1fr .9fr; gap: 56px; align-items: center; position: relative; z-index: 1; }
  .hero .eyebrow { color: #f3b58a; }
  .hero h1 { color: #fff; }
  .hero h1 span { color: #f3b58a; }
  .hero-lead { font-size: 1.15rem; color: #cfe0ea; max-width: 34em; margin-bottom: 2rem; }
  .hero-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 1rem; margin-bottom: 2.25rem; }
  .hero-actions .btn-outline { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.5); color: #fff; }
  .hero-actions .btn-outline:hover { background: #fff; color: var(--navy); }
  .hero-badges { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .6rem 1.4rem; font-size: .92rem; color: #cfe0ea; }
  .hero-badges span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .4rem; }
  .hero-badges svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; color: #f3b58a; }

  .hero-card {
    background: #fff; color: var(--ink); border-radius: 20px;
    padding: 28px; box-shadow: 0 30px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.25);
  }
  .hero-card-top { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 18px; }
  .hero-card-top h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.05rem; }
  .status {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .45rem;
    font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 700; color: #1e7a4a; background: #e6f6ec;
    padding: .3rem .7rem; border-radius: 999px;
  }
  .status::before { content: ""; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #22a35a; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(34,163,90,.2); }
  .hero-card .big { font-size: 2.1rem; font-weight: 800; color: var(--navy); margin: 0; line-height: 1.1; }
  .hero-card .sub { color: var(--muted); font-size: .95rem; margin-bottom: 20px; }
  .slots { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0 0 20px; display: grid; gap: 10px; }
  .slots li {
    display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
    padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; font-size: .95rem;
  }
  .slots li strong { color: var(--navy); }
  .slots li em { font-style: normal; font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--teal); background: var(--teal-light); padding: .2rem .55rem; border-radius: 6px; }
  .slots li em.full { color: var(--copper-dark); background: #fbeee4; }
  .hero-card .btn { width: 100%; }
  .hero-card small { display: block; text-align: center; margin-top: 12px; color: var(--muted); font-size: .8rem; }

  /* Trust strip */
  .trust { background: #fff; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
  .trust-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); }
  .trust-item { padding: 28px 20px; display: flex; gap: 14px; align-items: center; border-right: 1px solid var(--line); }
  .trust-item:last-child { border-right: 0; }
  .trust-icon {
    flex-shrink: 0; width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 12px;
    background: var(--teal-light); color: var(--teal); display: grid; place-items: center;
  }
  .trust-icon svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; }
  .trust-item strong { display: block; color: var(--navy); font-size: 1.02rem; }
  .trust-item span { color: var(--muted); font-size: .88rem; }

  /* Services */
  .services-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 22px; }
  .service-card {
    background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius);
    padding: 30px; transition: transform .2s, box-shadow .2s, border-color .2s;
  }
  .service-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: var(--shadow); border-color: #cfe4e6; }
  .service-icon {
    width: 52px; height: 52px; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--navy); color: #fff;
    display: grid; place-items: center; margin-bottom: 20px;
  }
  .service-icon svg { width: 26px; height: 26px; }
  .service-card.featured { background: var(--navy); border-color: var(--navy); color: #cfe0ea; }
  .service-card.featured h3 { color: #fff; }
  .service-card.featured .service-icon { background: var(--copper); }
  .service-card p { color: var(--muted); font-size: .97rem; margin-bottom: 1.1rem; }
  .service-card.featured p { color: #cfe0ea; }
  .service-card ul { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; font-size: .9rem; }
  .service-card li { padding: .35rem 0 .35rem 1.4rem; position: relative; }
  .service-card li::before {
    content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; top: .8rem; width: 10px; height: 6px;
    border-left: 2px solid var(--teal); border-bottom: 2px solid var(--teal); transform: rotate(-45deg);
  }
  .service-card.featured li::before { border-color: #f3b58a; }
  .tag {
    display: inline-block; font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .08em;
    background: #f3b58a; color: var(--navy); padding: .25rem .6rem; border-radius: 6px; margin-bottom: 14px;
  }

  /* Why / family */
  .why { background: #fff; }
  .why-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 64px; align-items: center; }
  .why-points { display: grid; gap: 28px; margin-top: 28px; }
  .why-point { display: flex; gap: 18px; }
  .why-point .num {
    flex-shrink: 0; width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--copper); color: #fff; font-weight: 800; display: grid; place-items: center;
  }
  .why-point p { color: var(--muted); margin: 0; }
  .why-point h3 { margin-bottom: .3em; }
  .family-panel {
    position: relative; border-radius: 24px; padding: 40px;
    background: linear-gradient(145deg, var(--teal-light), #fff);
    border: 1px solid #cfe4e6;
  }
  .family-panel blockquote {
    margin: 0 0 24px; font-size: 1.22rem; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--navy); font-weight: 500;
  }
  .family-panel blockquote::before {
    content: "\201C"; display: block; font-size: 4rem; line-height: .6; color: var(--copper); font-family: Georgia, serif; margin-bottom: 8px;
  }
  .signature { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; }
  .avatar {
    width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--navy); color: #fff;
    display: grid; place-items: center; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.1rem;
  }
  .signature strong { display: block; color: var(--navy); }
  .signature span { font-size: .9rem; color: var(--muted); }
  .family-stats {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 12px; margin-top: 30px;
    padding-top: 26px; border-top: 1px solid #cfe4e6;
  }
  .family-stats div strong { display: block; font-size: 1.7rem; color: var(--teal); line-height: 1; }
  .family-stats div span { font-size: .85rem; color: var(--muted); }

  /* Process */
  .process-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 22px; position: relative; counter-reset: step; }
  .step {
    background: #fff; border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 28px 24px; border: 1px solid var(--line); position: relative;
  }
  .step::before {
    counter-increment: step; content: "0" counter(step);
    font-size: 2.2rem; font-weight: 800; color: var(--teal-light); -webkit-text-stroke: 1.5px var(--teal);
    display: block; margin-bottom: 10px; line-height: 1;
  }
  .step h3 { font-size: 1.08rem; }
  .step p { color: var(--muted); font-size: .95rem; margin: 0; }

  /* Pricing */
  .pricing { background: var(--navy); color: #cfe0ea; }
  .pricing h2, .pricing h3 { color: #fff; }
  .pricing .section-head p { color: #a9c3d1; }
  .pricing .eyebrow { color: #f3b58a; }
  .price-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 22px; }
  .price-card {
    background: var(--navy-2); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 32px 28px;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  }
  .price-card.popular { border: 2px solid var(--copper); position: relative; }
  .price-card.popular::before {
    content: "Most booked"; position: absolute; top: -14px; left: 28px;
    background: var(--copper); color: #fff; font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 800; padding: .3rem .8rem; border-radius: 999px;
  }
  .price-card .from { font-size: .85rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .08em; color: #a9c3d1; }
  .price { font-size: 2.6rem; font-weight: 800; color: #fff; margin: .25rem 0 .5rem; line-height: 1; }
  .price small { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; color: #a9c3d1; }
  .price-card p { font-size: .95rem; }
  .price-card ul { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0 0 28px; flex: 1; }
  .price-card li { padding: .5rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08); font-size: .95rem; display: flex; gap: .6rem; }
  .price-card li svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; color: #f3b58a; flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 3px; }
  .price-note { margin-top: 32px; font-size: .92rem; color: #a9c3d1; text-align: center; }

  /* Areas */
  .areas-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.2fr; gap: 56px; align-items: start; }
  .chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; }
  .chips li {
    background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 999px; padding: .5rem 1rem;
    font-weight: 600; color: var(--navy); font-size: .93rem;
  }
  .chips li.hl { background: var(--teal); color: #fff; border-color: var(--teal); }
  .areas-note { background: #fff; border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 28px; border: 1px solid var(--line); }
  .areas-note ul { padding-left: 1.2rem; color: var(--muted); }
  .areas-note li { margin-bottom: .4rem; }

  /* Reviews */
  .reviews { background: #fff; }
  .review-summary { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; margin-bottom: 36px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .stars { color: #e8a317; letter-spacing: 3px; font-size: 1.2rem; }
  .review-summary strong { font-size: 1.1rem; color: var(--navy); }
  .review-summary span { color: var(--muted); font-size: .95rem; }
  .reviews-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 22px; }
  .review {
    background: var(--cream); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 28px; border: 1px solid var(--line);
    display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  }
  .review p { color: var(--ink); font-size: .98rem; flex: 1; }
  .review .who { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-top: 16px; padding-top: 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
  .review .who div { width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; font-weight: 800; color: #fff; font-size: .9rem; }
  .review .who strong { display: block; font-size: .95rem; color: var(--navy); }
  .review .who span { font-size: .82rem; color: var(--muted); }

  /* Contact */
  .contact-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: .9fr 1.1fr; gap: 48px; align-items: start; }
  .contact-info { display: grid; gap: 18px; margin-top: 28px; }
  .contact-row { display: flex; gap: 16px; align-items: flex-start; }
  .contact-row .trust-icon { width: 44px; height: 44px; }
  .contact-row strong { display: block; color: var(--navy); }
  .contact-row span, .contact-row a { color: var(--muted); font-size: .97rem; }
  .emergency-banner {
    margin-top: 28px; background: #fbeee4; border: 1px solid #f0cdb0; border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 20px 22px;
    color: #6f3914; font-size: .95rem;
  }
  .emergency-banner strong { color: var(--copper-dark); }

  .form-card {
    background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 20px; padding: 36px; box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  }
  .form-card h3 { font-size: 1.4rem; }
  .form-card > p { color: var(--muted); font-size: .95rem; margin-bottom: 22px; }
  .form-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; }
  .form-grid .full { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
  label { display: block; font-size: .88rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--navy); margin-bottom: .35rem; }
  input, select, textarea {
    width: 100%; font: inherit; font-size: .97rem; color: var(--ink);
    padding: .8rem .95rem; border: 1.5px solid #d6d2c9; border-radius: 10px; background: #fff;
  }
  input:focus, select:focus, textarea:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--teal); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(27,127,134,.15); }
  textarea { min-height: 110px; resize: vertical; }
  .form-foot { margin-top: 20px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
  .form-foot .btn { width: 100%; }
  .form-foot small { color: var(--muted); font-size: .82rem; text-align: center; }

  /* FAQ */
  .faq-list { max-width: 820px; margin: 0 auto; display: grid; gap: 12px; }
  details {
    background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; padding: 18px 22px;
  }
  details[open] { box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
  summary { cursor: pointer; font-weight: 700; color: var(--navy); list-style: none; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
  summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
  summary::after { content: "+"; font-size: 1.4rem; color: var(--teal); line-height: 1; transition: transform .2s; }
  details[open] summary::after { transform: rotate(45deg); }
  details p { color: var(--muted); margin: 12px 0 0; }

  /* Footer */
  .site-footer { background: #0a1f2d; color: #a9c3d1; padding: 64px 0 28px; font-size: .95rem; }
  .footer-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.6fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 40px; }
  .site-footer h4 { color: #fff; font-size: .95rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .08em; margin-bottom: 16px; }
  .site-footer ul { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; display: grid; gap: 10px; }
  .site-footer a { color: #a9c3d1; }
  .site-footer a:hover { color: #fff; }
  .site-footer .logo { color: #fff; margin-bottom: 14px; }
  .site-footer .logo small { color: #7f99a8; }
  .footer-bottom {
    margin-top: 48px; padding-top: 24px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
    display: flex; justify-content: space-between; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; font-size: .85rem; color: #7f99a8;
  }

  /* Mobile sticky call bar */
  .mobile-call { display: none; }

  /* Responsive */
  @media (max-width: 980px) {
    .nav-links { display: none; }
    .hero-grid, .why-grid, .areas-grid, .contact-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 40px; }
    .trust-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
    .trust-item:nth-child(2) { border-right: 0; }
    .trust-item:nth-child(-n+2) { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
    .services-grid, .price-grid, .reviews-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
    .process-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
    .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
  }
  @media (max-width: 640px) {
    .nav-phone { display: none; }
    .services-grid, .price-grid, .reviews-grid, .process-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .trust-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .trust-item { border-right: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
    .trust-item:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
    .form-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .form-card { padding: 26px; }
    .family-stats { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr; }
    .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .hero-actions .btn { width: 100%; }
    .mobile-call {
      display: flex; position: fixed; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; z-index: 60;
      background: var(--copper); padding: 12px; justify-content: center; gap: 8px;
      box-shadow: 0 -6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.15);
    }
    .mobile-call a { color: #fff; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.05rem; text-decoration: none; }
    body { padding-bottom: 64px; }
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
    * { transition: none !important; }
  }
</style>
</head>

<a class="skip-link" href="#main">Skip to content</a>

<!-- HEADER -->
<header class="site-header">
  <div class="container nav">
    <a href="#top" class="logo" aria-label="Calder Family Plumbing home">
      <span class="logo-mark" aria-hidden="true">
        <svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#f3b58a" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 2.7s-6 6.6-6 11a6 6 0 0 0 12 0c0-4.4-6-11-6-11z"/><path d="M9 14.5a3 3 0 0 0 3 3"/></svg>
      </span>
      <span>Calder Family Plumbing<small>Leeds · Since 1987</small></span>
